findings.title: Import numeric guard does not bind a value to its source row
findings.recommendation: Bind decision values to bounded source tokens, row/column and condition anchors; visual review when association cannot be verified.
acceptance_criteria: Digit fragments in standards and other values refused
Wrong row or condition requires explicit review

findings.title: Snapshot date cannot pin a changed database
findings.recommendation: Use content-based release IDs in artifacts, scenario links and exports; preserve exact release artifacts and migration diffs.
acceptance_criteria: Same-date decision changes get distinct IDs
Saved scenario opens exact release or visible migration

findings.title: Consistency tests need independent engineering acceptance fixtures
findings.evidence_status: known human-review debt and test limitation
findings.recommendation: Add a small independently reviewed source-backed engineering scenario set and task sessions.
acceptance_criteria: Every requirement has reviewed four-state examples
Source anchors and outcomes survive release migration

findings.title: Multi-table writes and ledger updates lack recoverable transaction semantics
findings.evidence_status: code-established risk, no data loss reproduced
findings.recommendation: Stage validated changes, check pre-image hashes under a write lock and journal recovery including ledger updates.
acceptance_criteria: Failure injection leaves previous or next complete world
Exact reapply is no-op and divergent reapply reported

findings.title: SQLite debugging may mix current CSVs with stale compiled values
findings.recommendation: Generate/query views against one input identity; refuse or refresh stale compiled/SQLite inputs.
acceptance_criteria: Measurement edit refreshes or refuses current query
Raw and compiled views share identity

findings.title: Fetches need bounded execution and durable progress
findings.recommendation: Add explicit connection/body deadlines, size limits, transient retry handling and per-document progress journal.

findings.title: Live ingestion remains tied to dated campaign and broad reader
findings.recommendation: Introduce explicit context/proposal/state contracts and modularize by evidence responsibility while retaining history.
acceptance_criteria: Fixture works under isolated new context
Adapters have scoped parity and independent source fixtures

findings.title: Source replay relies on local cache without stated durable recovery contract
findings.evidence_status: documented limitation; external backups not inventoried
findings.recommendation: Document and implement private digest-addressed evidence bundle/store and restore manifest.

findings.title: Quick start omits root dependencies and release browser checks may skip
findings.recommendation: Provide executable clean-clone bootstrap/doctor and require browser checks for release verification.
acceptance_criteria: Missing required browser cannot pass release gate

findings.title: Current operations are obscured by history and a manual import walkthrough
findings.evidence_status: onboarding design limitation and instruction conflict
findings.recommendation: Provide short engineer/correction/authorized-import routes; mark historical examples and smoke-test current examples.
acceptance_criteria: Correct route identified in one page
Examples run isolated without hidden personal inputs

findings.title: Measure complete fast loop and realistic corpus growth before optimizing
findings.evidence_status: performance recommendation; current timing supplied by root
findings.recommendation: Measure cold/warm/decision-edit loops, strict fast budgets and targeted freshness-safe routes; optimize observed model and browser bottlenecks.
acceptance_criteria: Subset checks distinguished from release gate

findings.title: Cache promise needs a supported process/installation contract
findings.evidence_status: isolated key probe; no wrong decision established
findings.recommendation: Declare immutable one-shot loaded code contract or revalidate supported dynamic inputs before cache hits.
acceptance_criteria: Changed supported inputs cannot use old entry
